extracted.name: Easy Energy Bars
extracted.description: Made with 7 simple ingredients, these chocolate, flax, and oat-stuffed energy bars are the perfect pick-me-up snack when you're on the go.
instruction_lines: Stir oats, chocolate chips, flax meal, peanut butter, honey, vanilla extract, and salt together in a bowl. Roll into 24 balls and refrigerate until firm, at least 30 minutes.
